{{short description|Intercollegiate basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |sport=Women's basketball |year=2022–23 |team=Penn Quakers |image=Penn Quakers logo.svg |image_size=150 |conference=Ivy League |division= |short_conf=Ivy |CoachRank= |APRank= |record= 17–12 |conf_record= 9–5 |head_coach=[[Mike McLaughlin (basketball)|Mike McLaughlin]] |hc_year = 13th |asst_coach1=Kelly Killion |asst_coach2=Ashley Robinson |asst_coach3=Jim Ricci |stadium=[[Palestra]] |champion= |tourney=[[2023 Women's National Invitation Tournament|WNIT]] |tourney_result=first round }} {{2022–23 Ivy League women's basketball standings}} The '''2022–23 Penn Quakers women's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Pennsylvania]] during the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I women's basketball season]]. The Quakers, led by thirteenth-year head coach [[Mike McLaughlin (basketball)|Mike McLaughlin]], played their home games at the [[Palestra]] in [[Philadelphia]], Pennsylvania as members of the [[Ivy League]]. The Quakers qualified for the [[2023 Ivy League women's basketball tournament|Ivy League women's tournament]] for the fourth time but lost to [[2022–23 Princeton Tigers women's basketball team|Princeton]] in the semifinals.{{Cite web |last=Tannenwald |first=Jonathan |date=March 11, 2023 |title=Penn loses to Princeton, 77-70, in Ivy League men’s tournament semifinals |url=https://www.inquirer.com/college-sports/penn/college-basketball-ivy-league-tournament-penn-princeton-score-men-20230311.html |access-date=March 11, 2023 |website=The Philadelphia Inquirer |language=en}} They lost to [[2022–23 Richmond Spiders women's basketball team|Richmond]] in the first round of the [[2023 WNIT]].{{Cite web |date=2023-03-16 |title=Women's Basketball's WNIT Run Concludes At Richmond, 75-52 |url=https://pennathletics.com/news/2023/3/16/wbb-wnit-run-concludes-at-richmond-75-52.aspx |access-date=2025-03-17 |website=University of Pennsylvania Athletics |language=en}} ==Previous season== Penn finished the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I women's basketball season|2021–22 season]] 12–14, 7–7 in Ivy League play.
